issues.problem: hodo-nai mistake 2 (昨日は今日ほど寒くない) is a correct sentence; it was only 'wrong' against an unstated intended meaning.
issues.action: Replaced with a real error: 思ったほど難しかった (affirmative after ほど) -> 思ったより難しかった.

issues.problem: hodo-nai explain claimed ほど 'never' works with an affirmative predicate, which is false for the extent use (象ほど大きい) and gave no way to say 'as ... as'.
issues.action: Restricted the claim to the comparison sense and added AはBと同じくらい寒い for affirmative 'as ... as'.

issues.problem: explain said 頃 is ごろ only directly after a time word; このごろ / 近頃 are voiced counterexamples.
issues.action: Reworded: ころ after の/その, ごろ after a time word, このごろ noted as a fixed word.

issues.problem: tip was wordy and its 'at what time?' test was confusing.
issues.action: Shortened to: a moment on the clock or calendar -> ごろ; a length or amount -> くらい.
